reason: The argument is correct. The CRT construction gives both required gcd identities; the residue class modulo p(p-1) is reduced, so Dirichlet applies. The hypothesis then forces ord_p(x) to divide gcd(ℓ−1,p−1)=2, hence p divides x²−1 for every prime p≡1 (mod 4) not dividing y. Infinitely many such primes force x²−1=0, and positivity gives x=1.
